name: mfi_workload_dynamics_stress_tests
purpose: Sensitivity analysis only; not part of the paper-candidate replication track
shared_controls: Same sampled profile sequence per scenario and repetition
Same offered-load axis based on Table I Slice No. units

modes.paper_candidate: One job per slot; durations uniform in [1,T].
modes.burst_arrivals: All arrivals at time zero; same profiles and durations as paper_candidate.
modes.sparse_arrivals: Inter-arrival gap doubled to two slots; same profiles and durations.
modes.short_lifetimes: Durations uniform in [1,floor(T/4)]; same profile sequence.
modes.long_lifetimes: Durations uniform in [ceil(0.75*T),T]; same profile sequence.
modes.no_completion_before_stream_end: Durations T+1; no positive-duration job completes before the final arrival.

interpretation: These modes identify sensitivity to arrival and lifetime dynamics. Do not select a mode because it creates a desired MFI-vs-baseline performance gap.
